tasks.title: Implement fizzbuzz with tests
tasks.prompt: Create fizzbuzz.py at the worktree root with a function fizzbuzz(n: int) -> str that returns "Fizz" for multiples of 3, "Buzz" for multiples of 5, "FizzBuzz" for multiples of both, and str(n) otherwise. Create test_fizzbuzz.py at the worktree root with pytest cases covering 3, 5, 15, and a plain number. The verification command is `python -m pytest -q test_fizzbuzz.py`.

tasks.title: Implement slugify with tests
tasks.prompt: Create slugify.py at the worktree root with slugify(text: str) -> str: lowercase the text, replace runs of whitespace and underscores with a single hyphen, remove all characters other than a-z, 0-9 and hyphens, collapse consecutive hyphens, and strip leading/trailing hyphens. Example: slugify("Hello, World!") == "hello-world". Create test_slugify.py at the worktree root with pytest cases covering punctuation removal, whitespace runs, and leading/trailing hyphen stripping. The verification command is `python -m pytest -q test_slugify.py`.

tasks.title: Implement roman numeral conversion with tests
tasks.prompt: Create roman.py at the worktree root with to_roman(n: int) -> str for 1 <= n <= 3999 using standard subtractive notation (4 -> "IV", 9 -> "IX", 40 -> "XL", 90 -> "XC", 400 -> "CD", 900 -> "CM"); raise ValueError outside the range. Create test_roman.py at the worktree root with pytest cases covering 1, 4, 9, 14, 40, 90, 400, 900, 1994, 3999, and ValueError for 0 and 4000. The verification command is `python -m pytest -q test_roman.py`.

tasks.title: Fix the median bug in textkit
tasks.prompt: tests/test_stats.py in this repository currently fails because textkit/stats.py has a bug in median(). Fix the bug in textkit/stats.py; do not modify tests/test_stats.py. The verification command is `python -m pytest -q tests/test_stats.py`.

tasks.title: Implement semver parsing and comparison with tests
tasks.prompt: Create semver.py at the worktree root with parse_semver(version: str) -> tuple parsing "MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH" into a tuple of three ints, raising ValueError for anything else (wrong segment count, empty segments, non-digit characters), and compare_semver(a: str, b: str) -> int returning -1, 0, or 1 by comparing parsed versions. Create test_semver.py at the worktree root with pytest cases covering parsing, invalid inputs ("1.2", "1.2.3.4", "a.b.c"), and comparisons where numeric ordering differs from string ordering (e.g. "1.10.0" > "1.9.0"). The verification command is `python -m pytest -q test_semver.py`.
